summary: I started the giant in the sandbox myself (reviews/r69-h1.png): Lumi towers over the trees with 'I'M HUGE!!!' and it looks good. The camera left it for a dance ring within seconds, and the film on the pages is a failed take.
surprise_why: A golden mushroom that makes Lumi taller than the trees is a funny moment worth showing a friend, and it works in the live game.

findings.what: The path traced film on the pages shows Lumi small while the riders float in the sky (the tracer ignores the herd scale), so the public post shows a failed take.
findings.evidence: author's journal 20:58; the live raster in my own shot r69-h1.png is right
findings.suggestion: Fix the tracer, re-film the giant, replace the post.

findings.what: In my run the camera left the giant after about 6 s and showed a dance ring, while the giant state was still 'giant' (r69-h2.png, r69-h3.png). The event's centrepiece is off screen for much of its time. I forced the start with begin!(least=0) while a dance ring was active and Lumi was marked asleep, so a natural start may differ. A 'Z' sleep icon also hung over the giant's head (r69-h1.png).
findings.where: plugins/giant.jl CAMERA_GROUPS/moment vs dancecircle; screen area 3D view
findings.suggestion: Put 'giant' into the camera MOMENTS_FIRST list or have the giant take dancers out of :circle, and clear the sleep icon on start.

findings.what: The 'Lumi' name tag and speech bubbles stay at the giant's knees, while the thought bubble is at its head. The #402 'shaking sheep' fix (arrive_at_edge!) is still unproven on a film.
findings.evidence: r69-h1.png (name tag at the feet); journal 21:09
findings.suggestion: Scale head_point for giants; film a walker sent into a bush with signed per-frame dx/dy.

agent_notes.failed traced film on the pages: kept on purpose: the post is captioned as an experiment that went wrong (rule 14 counts those). The cause is in RayMakie's traced meshscatter (ignores the model matrix), todo #416 with the exact place; a new giant take follows once the tracer is fixed and tested in a Julia session (none was available in s68-s70).
agent_notes.camera left the giant for a dance ring: fixed in s70: big moments (Main.BIG_MOMENTS: giant, egg) are asked through garden's MOMENTS_FIRST slot, before dance rings and every other moment. Sandbox: the camera watched the giant in 15 of 16 one-second samples (21:23). Published 21:24.
agent_notes.name tag and speech at the giant's knees: open: the tag and bubbles use the engine's head_point every frame (an engine edit to batch with others); #402 stays open until a measured walk film.
